{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# The Slurm -A (--account) directive has no direct equivalent in Flux.
# Account/project information is often handled by site-specific configurations.
# Omission of this directive may lead to the job being charged to a default account.
#FLUX: --queue=phillips
#FLUX: --job-name=filt1
#FLUX: --time=04:00:00
#FLUX: --nodes=1
#FLUX: --ntasks=1
#FLUX: --cpus-per-task=4

# This script is designed to be run as a Flux job array, for example: flux submit --job-name=filt1[0-39] script.sh
# The OMP_NUM_THREADS variable is set to match the cpus-per-task request.
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4

module load easybuild  icc/2017.1.132-GCC-6.3.0-2.27  impi/2017.1.132 skewer

cd /projects/phillipslab/ateterina/CR_popgen/data/reads/
LISTFILES=(*.fastq)

# The Slurm array task ID variable has been replaced with the Flux equivalent, ${FLUX_TASK_ID}.
file=${LISTFILES[$FLUX_TASK_ID]}

#remove adapter + qc
skewer -x AGATCGGAAGAG -t 4 -q 20 -l 36 -d 0.1 -r 0.1 -o ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1} $file ${file/_1.fastq/_2.fastq};


mv ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1-trimmed-pair1.fastq} ${file/_1.fastq/_fp1.ok.fastq}
mv ${file/_1.fastq/.tr1-trimmed-pair2.fastq} ${file/_1.fastq/_fp2.ok.fastq}
"
}
